description: This file contains functions for resolving command-line arguments and paths for a daemon process, including handling different runtimes (Node.js, Bun), development mode, and external binary resolution.

methods.name: resolveCliEntrypointPathForService
methods.description: Resolves the CLI entry point path for the service, considering distribution build artifacts and symlinks.

methods.name: resolveRealpathSafe
methods.description: Safely resolves the real path of a given input path, returning the original if resolution fails.

methods.name: buildDistCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of candidate distribution file paths based on input paths.

methods.name: appendDistCandidates
methods.description: Appends standard distribution file paths to candidates list if they exist.

methods.name: appendNodeModulesBinCandidates
methods.description: Adds distribution candidates based on node_modules/.bin directory structure.

methods.name: resolveRepoRootForDev
methods.description: Resolves the repository root directory for development mode based on the script's location.

methods.name: resolveBunPath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the Bun binary.

methods.name: resolveNodePath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the Node.js binary.

methods.name: resolveBinaryPath
methods.description: Resolves the path to a specified binary using system commands.

methods.name: resolveCliProgramArguments
methods.description: Determines the command-line arguments for launching the CLI, considering runtime and dev mode.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProgramArguments
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for starting the gateway process.

methods.name: resolveNodeProgramArguments
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for starting a Node.js process with specific parameters.
